title: Law of Zeus
reason: The cross-bet x10 mechanic is exact, but public sources do not disclose the operator-bound Boost arrival rate, Coin-winning-combination rate, transition matrix, reel strips or equivalent prospective probabilities needed to price the build race and exercise waiting time. Overall hit frequency 23.94% is not a Coin-win frequency and cannot substitute for it.

criticalBuildRace.formula: If r is the probability that the next relevant Boost-or-Coin-reset event is a Boost, P(reach x10 before reset)=r^9.
criticalBuildRace.warning: These are structural sensitivity thresholds, not measured game probabilities.

exerciseFloorAtX10.warning: This floor alone cannot establish EV because build cost/resets, ordinary returns and actual Coin-win frequency are unknown.

closure: No defensible +EV can be established from currently public evidence. Do not keep Law of Zeus as top lane unless operator-bound transition/frequency data or a sufficiently large prospective passive sample is recovered.
